### Stop Praying for Faith, Start Reading the Word
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-august-3-2026.html
Passage: Romans 10:17
Points:
- Dwight L. Moody pleaded with God for faith until realizing Scripture already explains how faith comes.
- Genuine faith cannot be produced through hunches, wishful thinking, or mere guesswork.
- Faith arises naturally as a direct by-product of hearing God's revealed truth.
- Believers gain spiritual confidence when they anchor their trust firmly in God's specific promises.

### Stuck with Paul
Author: John UpChurch
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-june-18-2013.html
Passage: Romans 10:14
Points:
- Paul's sharp teaching strips away self-righteousness and exposes legalism.
- Christians are prone to retreating into comfortable holy bubbles instead of engaging the world.
- Jesus consistently pursued sinners and met people right in the midst of their brokenness.
- People far from God cannot believe the gospel unless Christians go out and speak up.

### By the Word
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/word
Passage: Romans 10:17
Points:
- God ordinarily employs the proclamation of Scripture as the instrument to draw sinners to faith.
- Hearing the word of Christ both converts the lost and strengthens the faith of believers.
- The Holy Spirit works through the message of the cross to illuminate minds and resolve doubts.
- Christians should share the good news with confidence, trusting God to empower His Word.
